correctness.rationale: For every complex r not 0,+2,-2, smoothness follows from explicit partial derivatives and the first source. The exact symbolic Hessian equals -18X times the displayed quintic. Mod F on Z=1, H=54xP_r(y²), with resultant(P,g)=16(r²-4)² and P(0)=3r. Thus each cubic root contributes six smooth points, with Hessian local intersection multiplicity equal to root multiplicity; the four x=0 points give simple Hessian intersections, and infinity gives tangent contact four. The exact discriminant is 3(r²-4)(11r⁴-1080r²+3888); on the exceptional locus no triple root is possible. This yields precisely 1 hyperflex +22 ordinary or 7 hyperflexes+10 ordinary, with totals 24. Exact reproducible SymPy verification was run successfully from the actual verify.py; no sampled inference is used.

The two exact exceptional isomorphism classes and their six-point cyclic orbits provide a sharp natural moduli boundary in the classical seven-hyperflex locus.
